marks.name: glass-stung hand
marks.text: A hundred small stings, none worth naming. The grip argues with you.

marks.name: ringing ear
marks.text: One clear note, held since. It is almost a pleasant note.

marks.name: cracked rib
marks.text: It only hurts when the air comes in, which is often.

marks.name: wrenched knee
marks.text: The leg still works. It has opinions about when.

marks.name: split coat-seam
marks.text: The coat has opened a long grin down one side and will not close it.

marks.name: lamp-shy
marks.text: The lamp learned a flicker somewhere back there and will not unlearn it.

marks.name: shard in the boot
marks.text: Something small and patient, under the heel, arguing against running.

marks.name: cold sweat
marks.text: It arrives a little before the fear does, which is the unnerving part.

marks.name: bad night's blood
marks.text: Sleep comes. The mending forgets to.

marks.name: thousand-yard glaze
marks.text: You are resting. You are looking at nothing. Neither is helping.
